title: Overdrive workout, schema 1
description: Native workout format (spec §8.1). Targets are fractions of FTP, durations are seconds. A heart-rate step (type hr, spec §11.2) is the exception: its target is a heart rate and its power limits are absolute watts. ZWO files and intervals.icu workouts are converted to this format on import. live_coach, coach_brief and the steps' must_say (spec §12.1, ADR 0038) are for the live coach on the service: the agent writes them, the service keeps them (intervals.icu and Google Calendar never see them) and serves them on GET /v1/workouts, and the tablet reads live_coach to decide whether to start a live session. They are optional and additive: a reader that knows nothing of the live coach must not meet them until the agent first writes one.

live_coach.description: true: the live coach (spec §12.1) may speak short cues during this session. Absent or false: it is silent. The agent sets it for key or strict sessions.

coach_brief.description: What the session is for, what to watch in this rider and what tone to take: the agent's brief to the live coach's model. At most 1000 characters. Never shown to the rider on the tablet.

routeId.description: The id of a route (route.schema.json, spec §11.4) that backs a free step: the tablet rides it, its grade feeds the trainer. A free step without it is the flat free ride.

cadence.description: Target cadence in rpm. Shown only; never controls the trainer.

mustSay.description: A line the live coach speaks exactly as written, with no model involved (spec §12.1). at is "start" (as the step begins) or the second of the step to speak it at (at least 1, below the step's duration, checked beyond the schema). text is at most 80 characters, the length of any cue. Use sparingly.

mustSayList.description: At most 3 lines per step. Inside a repeat a step's lines are spoken at every pass.

hr.description: Heart-rate hold (spec §11.2): ERG mode whose target power is chosen by a slow controller so that the heart rate stays at the target. Exactly one of target_bpm and target_lthr. power_min < power_max is checked beyond the schema (every implementation does, see the invalid fixtures). No FTP is needed.

target_bpm.description: Target heart rate in beats per minute.

target_lthr.description: Target heart rate as a fraction of the rider's threshold heart rate. The service resolves it to target_bpm from the profile when it serves the workout to the tablet; a workout with this form is only created while a threshold is known.

band.description: Half-width of the band around the target in bpm: the heart rate is inside the band when it is within this many bpm of the target. Compliance for the step is the time inside the band. Default 5.

power_min.description: The least power in watts the controller may command; the start ramp begins here, and it is where the power drops to when the strap signal is lost for 60 s.

power_max.description: The most power in watts the controller may command. Greater than power_min.

steps.description: Repeats do not nest in schema 1.
